content.short: Reviving 5555 Dodo's back from their little break called Extinction for us Humans to play games with.
content.description:
About 500 years ago the Dutch discovered the Dodo. Now it's the Dutch that are reviving them! The Cardodo project started in December 2021 by Chief, Tech & Señor. All three are from The Netherlands. Our mission is to revive the Dodo on the Cardano Blockchain. With our pre-sale that started 1st of February we're securing funds to develop a prototype of the Cardodo P2E Game.

The Cardodo game will have a competitive edge, but is mostly focussed on community-first and entertainment. On our Roadmap we balance Community and Game Development in our Investment Transparency. For a detailed breakdown of our goals and vision, read the Cardodo roadmap. The team firmly believes in underpromising and overdelivering, a core value that seems to be a first in the NFT community. Questions?

Feel free to reach out to the team. They're switched ON.
